title: SpaceX Approved to Deploy 1 Million Starmind Satellites
summary: The FCC has approved SpaceX to deploy one million Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit.

title: NASA Deploys Aircraft for US Army Detonation Monitoring
summary: NASA is sending research aircraft and using satellites as the Army prepares to detonate degrading explosives in Iowa.

title: Study Links Drained Peatlands to Long-Term Warming
summary: A new study reveals that the long-term decomposition of drained bogs, fens, and swamps causes about three percent of human-caused climate warming.

title: Volcanic Eruptions Create New Beaches on Iwo Jima
summary: Satellites captured images of new land created by a volcanic eruption, extending the beaches of Iwo Jima.

title: Conductive Polymer Hair Dyes Turn Hair Into EEG Electrodes
summary: Researchers developed electrically conductive polymer hair dyes that function as gel-free EEG electrodes for brain monitoring.

title: ESA Unveils First Close-Ups of Asteroid Dimorphos
summary: The European Space Agency shares the Hera probe's first images of asteroid Dimorphos following NASA's DART impact.

title: UK Space Agency Funds Seven Climate Services Projects
summary: The UK Space Agency is funding seven projects utilizing satellite data to support climate change management.

title: Jacobs to Design DFW Airport Rail Modifications
summary: Jacobs has been appointed to design automated rail system modifications for Dallas Fort Worth International Airport's new terminal.

title: Wearable Tech Turns Arm Skin Into a Trackpad
summary: Researchers developed technology that uses a wearer's arm skin as a functional trackpad to control smartwatches.

title: Semiconductor Engineering Technical Paper Roundup
summary: Recent technical papers cover hybrid-bonded 3D NAND, defect-aware chiplet matching, and backside clock meshes.

title: Rare Mercedes-Benz C 111-II Heading to Auction
summary: A surviving experimental Mercedes-Benz C 111-II supercar with a four-rotor Wankel engine is headed to auction.

title: UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism Risks Infrastructure Sector
summary: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism is a new tax on carbon intensive goods imported into the UK starting in January 2027.

title: GM Plans Major Factory Automation Expansion
summary: General Motors plans a major increase in factory robotics on a tight timeline targeting 2028.

title: Stepped-Roof University Wins World Building of the Year
summary: Prestige University by Sanjay Puri Architects won the World Building of the Year award for its stepped roof design.

title: PyRUA-Dex Framework for Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: PyRUA-Dex enables coding agents to develop dexterous bimanual manipulation through programmatic policies without needing human demonstrations.

title: ROAM-Bench Evaluates Embodied Spatial Intelligence
summary: ROAM-Bench evaluates embodied active spatial intelligence and evidence verification under robot motion and collision constraints across 250 tasks.

title: Exploratory Midtraining Enhances Robot Policy Adaptability
summary: Researchers introduce beta-Data and an exploratory midtraining approach to build behavioral coverage and improve robot policy adaptation and online learning.

title: Neural Implicit Representation for Bathymetry Estimation
summary: Researchers proposed a differentiable neural rendering framework for sidescan sonar to improve underwater bathymetry estimation.

title: ClusterVAD Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection Model
summary: ClusterVAD is an unsupervised voice activity detection method built on frozen speech foundation model representations without requiring training labels.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting via Generative Policies
summary: An online reinforcement learning method combines stochastic differential equation sampling with value-based policy optimization for autonomous vehicle drifting.

title: SHARPnP Hyperspectral Super-Resolution Framework
summary: SHARPnP is an interpretable framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements.

title: Embodied AI Vulnerability to Mirrored Environments
summary: A study on RoboDojo-Mirror reveals that mirrors significantly reduce the aggregate success rates of diverse robotic manipulation policies.

title: CAPER Framework for Robotic Assembly Planning
summary: CAPER uses PartGround and PlanRefine modules to help vision-language models generate reliable manual-guided robotic assembly procedures with finite inventory consistency.

title: VidForce Estimates Force and Articulation from Video
summary: VidForce estimates interaction trajectories and force profiles from third-person RGB videos to drive real-world articulated-object manipulation.

title: Framework for Level 4 Autonomous Vehicle Architecture Rationalization
summary: Researchers propose an Operational Design Domain-based systems-engineering framework to optimize fault-tolerant architectures and reduce lifecycle costs for Level 4 autonomous vehicles.

title: Lembas Framework Optimizes Video RAG Token Allocation
summary: A new plug-and-play framework formulates video retrieval-augmented generation as a token allocation problem, improving accuracy while significantly reducing computational overhead.

title: China Launches Shenzhou-24 to Tiangong Space Station
summary: China launched the Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft to the Tiangong space station, welcoming its first international visitor.

title: QoS-Constrained Sum-Rate Maximization in RIS-Assisted Systems
summary: A study investigates joint optimization for pinching-antenna NOMA systems assisted by a reconfigurable intelligent surface.

title: DOPER 6D Object Pose Estimation Framework
summary: Researchers present DOPER, a real-time RGB pose estimation framework that recovers the 6D pose of known objects using a shared visual backbone and geometric constraints.

title: Four Companies Form Dual-Use Space Mission Partnership
summary: Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space signed an MOU to cooperate on complete dual-use space missions.
